rows.grounds: adjective modifying mandala; supplied token lacks final nasal

items.question: What complete white mandala of nectar-nature should one meditate upon?
items.inference: The practitioner should visualize a complete white nectar-natured mandala.
uncertainties: The supplied token saṃpūrṇa lacks the expected final nasal.
items.plain_english: One should meditate on the complete, white mandala that is of nectar-nature.
